overall_feedback: The manuscript is polished and compilation-ready, but it violates the locked evaluation specification. The artifacts evaluate perturbed synthetic digit cells and five hand-selected faults; they omit promised end-to-end form/OMR validation, QR/ArUco and candidate-isolation ablations, and a direct fact-write bypass test. Current evidence is insufficient for the stated architecture and industrial-form claims.

comments.title: Locked evaluation specification is not implemented
comments.quote: We provide a deterministic evaluation package covering 4,350 synthetic image cases, calibration/evaluation seed separation, seven perturbation families, five fault injections, resilience checks, and 70 automated tests.
comments.explanation: The locked design requires structured forms, OMR, QR/ArUco ablations, candidate-bypass/direct-fact attempts; artifacts evaluate digit cells and five faults only. The agreed validation scope is not implemented.
comments.fix: Run and report end-to-end form/OMR/QR/ArUco ablations plus explicit direct-fact bypass attempts; regenerate artifacts, results, and the claim ledger.
